title: Two-tape machine format
statement: There is a machine format whose codes represent deterministic machines with exactly two work tapes, binary tape symbols, and state set $\{0,\ldots,n\}$ when the code's state-count parameter is $n$. Each code's machine serialization is the fixed two-tape serialization, and the format's table skipper is the fixed two-tape table skipper.
hypotheses_covered: The inherited code format has its serialization and table-reading properties.
The coded machines have exactly two work tapes.
The coded machines use Boolean tape symbols and states indexed by Fin (numStates + 1).
Serialization agrees with the fixed two-tape machine serialization.
The table skipper agrees with the fixed two-tape table skipper.
